_comment: Shared case table for the skill-size gate's twin harnesses (issue #14, AC4b).
ONE data file, consumed by BOTH tests/check-skill-size.test.sh (via jq) and
tests/check-skill-size.test.ps1 (via ConvertFrom-Json), so the two twins can
never hand-sync-drift: they share the case DATA, each keeps its own runner.
Every skill's `desc`/`body` filler is expressed as a word COUNT, not literal
text — the gate only counts words, so a word count is a behaviourally exact
and language-neutral fixture (the assertions never inspect filler text). All
fields are always present (no optional keys) so both jq `//`-free access and
PowerShell Set-StrictMode -Version Latest property access stay clean.
Schema:
cases[]        one fixture case
desc           label for the exit-code assertion (also the case label)
skills[]       SKILL.md fixtures to write (empty = the zero-skills case)
kind           'inline' (description: <words> on one line) |
'block'  (description: >- with the words on an indented body line)
name           skill dir under skills/ (may contain '/' for nesting)
descWords      word count of the description scalar/body
bodyWords      word count of the SKILL.md body after the frontmatter
expectExit     required gate exit code
expectContains[]  substrings required in merged stdout+stderr
desc           label for the substring assertion (matches legacy output)
needle         the required substring
